page: OVHcloud b2-30 is a general-purpose cloud server configured with 8 dedicated physical cores on the x86_64 architecture, utilizing Intel Haswell processors running at 2.0 GHz. The instance is provisioned with 30.0 GB of system memory, yielding 3.75 GB per core, and includes 200 GB of local SSD storage. It operates on a KVM hypervisor and includes one complimentary public IPv4 address.

Performance benchmarks indicate a clear distinction between single-core and multi-core workloads. Single-core processing, such as stress-ng single-core and Geekbench single-core tests, falls into the poor to weak categories, reflecting the older Haswell CPU architecture. However, multi-core execution scales to average levels, as demonstrated by stress-ng multi-core, Geekbench multi-core, and Passmark CPU scores. Memory performance follows a similar pattern, with cached small-block reads performing at average speeds, while uncached large-block writes and reads show poor to weak throughput.

Given the dedicated CPU allocation combined with older processor architecture, the b2-30 offers a cost-efficient profile for workloads requiring sustained, non-burstable resources without needing the highest single-thread performance. It is well-suited for multi-threaded applications, static web serving, Redis database operations, and moderate software compilation tasks. It is less suitable for single-threaded processing, memory-intensive uncached operations, or modern LLM inference.
description: The OVHcloud b2-30 is a general-purpose virtual server featuring 8 dedicated Intel Haswell physical cores running at 2.0 GHz on the x86_64 architecture. It is equipped with 30.0 GB of RAM (3.75 GB per core) and 200 GB of local SSD storage, running on a KVM hypervisor. Benchmarks reveal that while single-core performance and uncached memory write speeds are weak to poor, multi-core execution and cached memory bandwidth reach average tiers. This makes the instance a cost-effective choice for sustained, multi-threaded workloads that do not require cutting-edge single-thread speeds. It is best suited for static web serving, Redis operations, software compilation, and general-purpose multi-threaded applications.
